title: 數量詞
point: 數量詞題先看後面的名詞是可數還是不可數、單數還是複數，再看動詞跟著誰變。
formula: Neither / Either / Each / One + of the + 複數名詞 + 單數動詞

parts.text: at least two years of sales experience

table.zh: 有幾家供應商、幾乎沒有供應商
table.rule: a few、few 接可數複數名詞；a few 偏肯定，few 偏否定

table.zh: 有一點時間、幾乎沒時間
table.rule: a little、little 接不可數名詞；a little 偏肯定，little 偏否定
many 接可數複數名詞，much 接不可數名詞
each、every 接單數名詞，動詞用單數

table.en: Neither of the rooms is available.
table.rule: neither / either / each / one of the + 複數名詞，動詞跟前面的數量詞用單數

table.en: all of the staff / most of the orders
table.rule: all、most of the 後面的名詞決定動詞：不可數或單數用單數動詞，複數名詞用複數動詞

examples: Neither of the proposals meets the budget limit for this year.
One of the printers on the third floor needs a new toner cartridge.
story: Ms. Lee received quotes from three hotels for the sales conference in May.
Neither of the first two hotels has a room large enough for 200 guests.
Each of the quotes includes breakfast, but only a few offer free parking.
One of the event planners is visiting the third hotel tomorrow.

drills.prompt: Can either of the first two hotels hold 200 guests?
drills.fix: Neither of the + 複數名詞 表示兩者都不，動詞用單數 has。

drills.prompt: Do all three quotes include breakfast?
drills.fix: Each of the quotes 指每一份都有，動詞跟 each 用單數 includes。

drills.prompt: Either of the dates ___ fine for the client.
drills.fix: Either of the + 複數名詞，動詞跟 either 用單數 is。
